author: Zephyr V
title: CPS_v4 Deep Operation 1 v7 - GPU Matrix Multiplication for Depth
abstract: Starts v7 deep triad with 2048x2048 GPU matrix multiplication using helper; emits beacon.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.sas.tools.gpu_mm import gpu_matrix_multiply

# Execute GPU matrix mult for size 2048
size = 2048
beacon_value = gpu_matrix_multiply(size)

# Emit for logs
print(json.dumps({
    "label": "CPS_v4:Deep_D1_v7 mm_2048x2048",
    "beacon": beacon_value
}))

# Append via helper
import subprocess
subprocess.call([
    'python',
    'storage/shared/meta/sas/tools/emit_cps_v4_beacon.py',
    'Zephyr V',
    'CPS_v4:Deep_D1_v7 mm_2048x2048',
    str(beacon_value),
    'sentinel_delta',
    '7.0'
])
